company.name: UCLA Smart Grid Energy Research Center (SMERC)

positions.title: Undergraduate Student Researcher
positions.description:
●	Assisted the research staff on applied research projects by providing computer, software, and hardware support and solutions as well as report maintenance and security problems
●	Performed troubleshooting and contributed to the ongoing improvement of research processes, including the integration of new technology and solutions on demonstration projects
●	Produced detailed reports on project status, testing protocols, and procedures

company.name: Bourns College of Engineering, Center of Environmental Research & Technology

positions.title: Suplemental Instruction Leader
positions.description:
●	Supplemented the learning of about 30 students and planned the sessions based on the professor’s lecture
●	Scheduled and coordinated SI sessions and appointments
●	Maintained utmost discretion when dealing with sensitive topics

projects.title: Vulnerability analysis and risk assessment of EV charging system under cyber-physical threats
projects.description:
●	Vulnerability analysis and risk assessment for several failure scenario case studies of the EV WinSmartEV™ charging system on the UCLA campus
●	Research about the impacts and cost of potential cyber-physical attacks

projects.title: Solar PV Greenhouse
projects.description:
●	Programed a micro-computer with a python script to record data for managing the state of charge of the batteries as well as the charging/discharging cycles
●	Recorded and visualized energy data generated by the transparent solar PV system
●	Developed a communication protocol using Modbus to communicate with the charge/load controllers and CAN bus to communicate with the battery management system of a lithium-ion battery pack

publications.title: Vulnerability Analysis and Risk Assessment of EV Charging System under Cyber-Physical Threats
publications.publisher: 2019 IEEE Transportation Electrification Conference and Expo, Novi, MI · Jan 1, 2019
